entities.name: Carlos José Ñáñez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carlos José Ñáñez is an Argentinian prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as Auxiliary Bishop of Córdoba from 1990 to 1995 when he was appointed Archbishop Coadjutor of Tucumán. He was Archbishop of Córdoba from 1998 to 2021.
